---
title: "A discovered preview image does not inherit the site's size"
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/square.svg">'
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image:height"'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width"'
---

![A square](square.svg){.preview-image}

The size the site declares describes the site image, not this page's preview image.
